tools.description: Find the cities with an Atmy air-quality summary by name (any language) or country. Returns slugs to pass to the other tools.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

query.description: Part of the city name in any site language.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.title: Search cities

tools.description: PM2.5 now in a city (mean of the latest reading of each eligible sensor, at most 60 minutes old) with its US EPA category and the weather now (temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, clouds, precipitation), plus the last completed day from the Atmy Data Hub with its weather. Pass city or lat/lon.

city.description: City name in any of the site languages, a slug like "russia/krasnoyarsk", or the Atmy city id.

country.description: Country name, to tell apart cities with the same name.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

lat.description: Latitude; with lon, the nearest city with an Atmy summary within 50 km.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.title: Current air quality

tools.description: Daily PM2.5 of a city from the Atmy Data Hub (UTC days, sensors after the quality check) with the day's weather from 2026-01-19 (mean, lowest and highest temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, strongest gust, clouds): the last days, or any period since 2017 with from/to, at most 400 days per call. For the whole history or records use get_air_quality_monthly first.

city.description: City name in any of the site languages, a slug like "russia/krasnoyarsk", or the Atmy city id.

country.description: Country name, to tell apart cities with the same name.

days.description: How many days back from the last completed day; ignored with from/to.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

lat.description: Latitude; with lon, the nearest city with an Atmy summary within 50 km.

to.description: Last day YYYY-MM-DD; default the last completed day.

tools.name: get_air_quality_history
tools.title: Daily air quality history

tools.description: The whole measurement history of a city from the Atmy Data Hub: PM2.5 per month with the month's weather from 2026-01, yearly means (complete years marked), the dirtiest and cleanest months and days. For questions like "how has the air changed" or "the most polluted month on record".

city.description: City name in any of the site languages, a slug like "russia/krasnoyarsk", or the Atmy city id.

country.description: Country name, to tell apart cities with the same name.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

lat.description: Latitude; with lon, the nearest city with an Atmy summary within 50 km.

tools.name: get_air_quality_monthly
tools.title: Monthly air quality history

tools.description: The next hours of a city: temperature, wind, humidity, precipitation and the pollution accumulation index 0–100 (how strongly the weather keeps particles near the ground). A weather estimate, not a PM2.5 forecast.

city.description: City name in any of the site languages, a slug like "russia/krasnoyarsk", or the Atmy city id.

country.description: Country name, to tell apart cities with the same name.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

lat.description: Latitude; with lon, the nearest city with an Atmy summary within 50 km.

tools.name: get_city_forecast
tools.title: Weather and pollution accumulation forecast

tools.description: Cities of a country ranked by daily PM2.5 for the last completed day (Atmy Data Hub), most polluted or cleanest first.

country.description: Country name in any site language or the ISO code, e.g. "Russia", "Сербия", "DE".

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

settlements.description: Large cities only, or every settlement with enough sensors.

tools.name: get_country_ranking
tools.title: Country ranking

tools.description: The sensor networks in Atmy (Sensor.Community, AirGradient, Atmy) with their number of sensors, how many pass the quality check, and their license.
tools.name: list_sensor_networks
tools.title: Sensor networks

tools.description: Single sensors with their latest reading (PM1, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, humidity, pressure), network and quality check: status, rating 0–10 of the last checked day, the mean rating of the last 7 days and the reasons. Filter by city, country, or a point with a radius; sort=rating puts the most reliable sensors first.

city.description: City slug like "serbia/belgrade" or the Atmy city id (find it with search_cities).

country.description: Country slug, the first part of a city slug, e.g. "serbia".

lat.description: With lon: sensors within radius_km of this point.

min_rating.description: Only sensors with at least this rating on their last checked day.

quality.description: passed: only sensors that pass the quality check.

tools.name: find_sensors
tools.title: Find sensors

tools.description: One sensor by its id: location, network, license, quality check with rating and reasons, and the latest reading.
tools.name: get_sensor
tools.title: One sensor

tools.description: Readings of one sensor: raw (the last 31 days, at most 7 days a call), 5-minute means (the same windows), hourly means (the last 366 days, at most 92 days a call) or daily means (UTC days of the last 366 days, with the quality check of each day). Default: the last 24 hours, or 30 days by day. Times are UTC.

to.description: ISO 8601 date or time, UTC; default now.

tools.name: get_sensor_readings
tools.title: Sensor readings

annotations.title: Mean of a group of sensors

tools.description: The mean of up to 100 sensors per 5 minutes, hour or UTC day, each sensor counted once per bucket, with the number of sensors in each bucket. Windows as in get_sensor_readings; by day at most 92 days a call.

to.description: ISO 8601 date or time, UTC; default now.

tools.name: get_sensors_average
tools.title: Mean of a group of sensors
